tools.name: search_mcps
tools.description: Search the BotMarket catalog of MCP servers. Returns name, description, category, GitHub URL, install command, and stars. Use to discover MCPs for a given capability or client (e.g. 'github', 'postgres', 'cursor').

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Search the BotMarket catalog of A2A-compatible AI agents. Each agent is self-describing via .well-known/agent-card.json.

tools.name: search_protocols
tools.description: List protocols tracked by BotMarket: MCP, A2A, x402, MTP (Machine Tree Protocol), MRP, L402, AP2, ACP, ANP, AGNTCY, etc. Filter by kind: payments | agents | context | discovery | identity.

tools.name: get_x402_services
tools.description: List services accepting agent-native payments (x402, MTP, MRP, L402).

tools.name: list_quests
tools.description: List BotMarket quests. Each quest pays USDC for completing a verifiable task (e.g. replicate a ceiba node, submit a verified MCP).

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get global BotMarket stats (counts of agents, MCPs, protocols, etc).
